claims: The Artemis II crew successfully completed a 10-day mission around the Moon.
The Artemis II crew splashed down on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II crew includes NASA commander Reid Wiseman.
The Artemis II crew includes pilot Victor Glover.
The Artemis II crew includes mission specialist Christina Koch.
The Artemis II crew includes Canadian Space Agency (CSA) mission specialist Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II crew were the first humans to travel to the Moon in over 50 years.
Reid Wiseman is a NASA astronaut.
Reid Wiseman is a U.S. Navy veteran.
Reid Wiseman previously served as Chief of the Astronaut Office.
Victor Glover is a NASA astronaut.
Victor Glover piloted the SpaceX Crew-1 mission.
Victor Glover is the first person of color to go to the Moon.
Christina Koch is a NASA astronaut.
Christina Koch holds the record for the longest single spaceflight by a woman.
Christina Koch is the first woman to go to the Moon.
Jeremy Hansen is a Canadian Space Agency astronaut.
Jeremy Hansen is a former fighter pilot.
Jeremy Hansen is the first Canadian to go to the Moon.
The Artemis II crew successfully tested the Orion spacecraft's systems in deep space.
The Artemis II mission verified the capsule's heat shield during a high-speed reentry exceeding 24,000 mph.
